comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Skip hidden textareas during initial batch sizing**

This initialization path unconditionally uses `scrollHeight` for every textarea, but `scrollHeight` is `0` for textareas that are not laid out yet (for example, inside `display:none` containers). Because the next phase writes that value as an explicit pixel height, those fields can be initialized to `0px` and appear collapsed when later revealed until another input/resize recalculates them. The previous implementation avoided this for empty textareas by not forcing an initial height update, so this is a behavior regression for lazily shown forms.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
